name: Saegusa Karen
source:
A member of the idol group HINAMEL.
Her father holds an important position at one of the country's largest corporations, and she grew up wanting for nothing.

Active in show business since her days a child actress, she is strong-willed and fiercely proud.
She cannot stand it when things fail to go her way, yet she also knows exactly how to present herself at her most attractive and is quick to read the interests and power dynamics in any relationship.
She is unfailingly charming in front of fans, but the moment she steps offstage, she returns to her more direct, no-nonsense self.

[From in-game tips]
